scientific_integrity: One mathematical claim with exact worst-case bias, covariance-dependent variance, uniqueness proof, and small-noise correlation boundary layer. Numerical tests supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only two predetermined linear queries, known positive curvature and covariance parameters, unrestricted real query domain, Gaussian exponential-covariance noise with nugget. No nonlinear/adaptive/multi-query theorem or general publication-priority certificate.
title: A sharp correlation boundary layer for minimax two-query numerical differentiation
